post.summary: Set or clear processing restriction (admin, GDPR Art. 18)
post.description: Sets (`restrict: true`) or clears (`restrict: false`) the GDPR Art. 18 processing-restriction flag on a user. A restricted user's data is retained but further processing is blocked: the auth middleware rejects mutating requests (POST/PATCH/DELETE) with 403 while still allowing reads (GET). Optional `reason` is recorded for compliance. Emits USER_RESTRICTED or USER_UNRESTRICTED audit event. Idempotent calls (already in the requested state) return 400. Requires ADMIN role.
